  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delayed notification"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FinalResult" name="Final result" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequested" name="Clerk requests credit scoring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split" name="Agency response">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level1Result" messageRef="Msg_Level1Result"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display message to clerk: check again later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Final result received">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Catch_Level1Result" targetRef="Task_PresentResult_Immediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult_Immediate" targetRef="End_ResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotification" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Task_PresentResult_Delayed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult_Delayed" targetRef="End_ResultPresentedAfterDelay"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CreditScoringRequest" name="Credit scoring request" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"

                      sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Start_ScoringRequestReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result" messageRef="Msg_Level1Result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="Catch_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>

                      sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequested" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk">

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification received">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B6</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Final result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B9</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B10</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split" targetRef="Catch_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="Catch_Level1Result" targetRef="Task_PresentResult_Immediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotification" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult_Immediate" targetRef="End_ResultPresented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Task_PresentResult_Delayed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B10" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult_Delayed" targetRef="End_ResultPresentedAfterDelay"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Decision_Split" name="Result determined immediately?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel1Result" name="Send level 1 result to banking system" messageRef="Msg_Level1Result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level1ResultSent" name="Level 1 result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring (up to a few minutes)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFinalResult" name="Send final scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalResultSent" name="Final result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequestReceived" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_SendLevel1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="End_Level1ResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendFinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_SendFinalResult" targetRef="End_FinalResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFinalResult" name="Send final result" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalResultSent" name="Final result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult_Split" targetRef="Task_SendLevel1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult_Split" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="End_Level1ResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendFinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_SendFinalResult" targetRef="End_FinalResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B4</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Scoring result arrives">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B9</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentDelayed" name="Present result" messageRef="Msg_PresentResult">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_ClerkRequest" targetRef="Task_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="Gateway_Response_Split"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A7</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>

rules.instruction: When the description attributes its own processing steps to an outside party (such as staged computation, sending a reply, or reporting a delay) that happen between the process's request and a reply the process waits for: Model each processing step the description attributes to that outside party as a task inside a separate participant pool for that party, in the order the description gives. Connect the process's request to that pool with a message flow. Connect the party's messages back to the process with message flows into message intermediate catch events or receive tasks. Do not omit the party's steps, and do not reduce them to bare waits in the process pool.
rules.situation: the description attributes its own processing steps to an outside party (such as staged computation, sending a reply, or reporting a delay) that happen between the process's request and a reply the process waits for

rules.instruction: When the description says the process itself shows a message to a human user after it receives a notice from an outside party, for example a notice that a result will be late, and asks the user to check again later: Model the display of that message as a task in the process's own pool. Place it after the intermediate catch event that receives the outside party's notice and before the process continues to wait for the final reply. Label the task with the display action as the description states it. Do not replace the display with a catch event, and do not omit it.
rules.situation: the description says the process itself shows a message to a human user after it receives a notice from an outside party, for example a notice that a result will be late, and asks the user to check again later

rules.instruction: When the description says that an actor's software application outside the process starts the process by sending it a request, and that the process later sends results or delay notices back to that same application: Model the actor's application as a separate participant pool with no internal workflow, since the description gives it none. Draw a message flow from the application's pool to the message start event that the request starts, and draw a message flow from each specific task in the process that sends a result or delay notice to the application's pool. Do not attach these flows to the process's pool boundary, and do not omit the application because it is not the process's own role.
rules.situation: the description says that an actor's software application outside the process starts the process by sending it a request, and that the process later sends results or delay notices back to that same application

rules.instruction: When The description names an outside party that performs its own processing steps (such as a first scoring pass, a second longer scoring pass, or deciding whether a delay notice is needed) and then sends messages to the process, so the process only receives what the party does.: Model the outside party as a separate pool. Place each step it performs itself, including its internal processing and its decision points, as tasks and gateways in that pool, in the order the description states. Connect each message it sends to the process with a message flow from a send task in that pool to a message catch event in the process pool. Do not represent the outside party's own work as catch events in the process pool.
rules.situation: The description names an outside party that performs its own processing steps (such as a first scoring pass, a second longer scoring pass, or deciding whether a delay notice is needed) and then sends messages to the process, so the process only receives what the party does.

rules.instruction: When the description names an action or occurrence with a verb-object phrase, and the generated label for the corresponding task or catch event adds a recipient phrase (such as 'to <party>') or a generic wrapper verb (such as 'received' or 'send ... to') that the description does not use for that action: Label the task or event with the verb and object phrase the description uses for that action or occurrence. Do not add the name of a recipient or sender, and do not add a generic wrapper verb that the description does not use. Keep the label to that phrase, so that a reader can match it to the description's wording.
rules.situation: the description names an action or occurrence with a verb-object phrase, and the generated label for the corresponding task or catch event adds a recipient phrase (such as 'to <party>') or a generic wrapper verb (such as 'received' or 'send ... to') that the description does not use for that action

rules.instruction: When the description says that a request made in one system starts a separate process in another system, and that this started process is the one that exchanges messages with an outside party: Model the started process as its own participant pool. Give that pool a message start event and draw a message flow from the requesting task in the requesting pool to this message start event. Do not connect the two systems with a sequence flow or a plain start event.
rules.situation: the description says that a request made in one system starts a separate process in another system, and that this started process is the one that exchanges messages with an outside party

rules.instruction: When The description states that the process sends a request for a named piece of information to an outside party, and it names the requested information with its own noun phrase.: Model the sending step as a task labeled 'request' followed by the noun phrase the description uses for the requested information. Leave the send action, the recipient and any timing from the description out of the label, and do not replace the requested information's noun phrase with a generic word.
rules.situation: The description states that the process sends a request for a named piece of information to an outside party, and it names the requested information with its own noun phrase.

rules.instruction: When the description says that an outside party performs its own processing steps, such as reporting a delay or sending a result, and that the process waits for the message that step produces: Draw each message flow that carries such a message from the specific task in the outside party's pool that performs the sending step, not from the pool boundary. Connect that flow to the message intermediate catch event or receive task that waits for it. Where the same party sends a second message after its own further processing, model that message as a separate sending task in its pool with its own message flow. Keep the requesting party's message flows into its start event and from its sending tasks as the source of the request.
rules.situation: the description says that an outside party performs its own processing steps, such as reporting a delay or sending a result, and that the process waits for the message that step produces
